description: Source code for managing user statuses and custom statuses in Mattermost server, including functions for setting, getting, updating, and broadcasting user statuses and custom statuses.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct providing methods for user status management in Mattermost.

methods.name: GetUserStatusesByIds
methods.description: Retrieves statuses for a list of user IDs.

methods.name: SetStatusLastActivityAt
methods.description: Sets the last activity timestamp for a user and updates their status to away if needed.

methods.name: SetStatusOnline
methods.description: Sets a user's status to online.

methods.name: SetStatusOffline
methods.description: Sets a user's status to offline.

methods.name: SetStatusAwayIfNeeded
methods.description: Sets a user's status to away if conditions require it.

methods.name: SetStatusDoNotDisturbTimed
methods.description: Sets a user's status to DND for a specified duration.

methods.name: SetStatusDoNotDisturb
methods.description: Sets a user's status to DND.

methods.name: SetStatusOutOfOffice
methods.description: Sets a user's status to Out of Office.

methods.name: SaveAndBroadcastStatus
methods.description: Saves a user's status and broadcasts the update.

methods.name: GetStatusFromCache
methods.description: Retrieves a user's status from cache.

methods.name: UpdateDNDStatusOfUsers
methods.description: Periodically updates DND statuses for users, unsetting expired DNDs and broadcasting updates.

methods.name: SetCustomStatus
methods.description: Sets a custom status for a user, validating emoji and updating preferences.

methods.name: addRecentCustomStatus
methods.description: Adds a custom status to the user's recent statuses list.

methods.name: RemoveRecentCustomStatus
methods.description: Removes a custom status from the user's recent statuses list.
